in_marathi.name: Poorvi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Northern direction, Spring
in_marathi.long_meaning: Poorvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Poorvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Poorna' which means 'complete' or 'full'. The prefix 'Poo' in Poorvi signifies 'North'. Thus, Poorvi can be translated as 'Northern direction' or 'Spring'. The name Poorvi is associated with the onset of spring and is believed to bring prosperity and growth.
